maddeler.e:
ننصبن (form VII)
# نَنْصَبِنُ (nanṣabinu) /nan.sˤa.bi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
# نَنْصَبِنَ (nanṣabina) /nan.sˤa.bi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
# نَنْصَبِنْ (nanṣabin) /nan.sˤa.bin/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
